name: jungle-grid
label: Jungle Grid
description: Submit async compute jobs, monitor status and logs, and retrieve artifacts from Jungle Grid.

api_base_url.label: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Base URL for the Jungle Grid API. Keep the default unless Jungle Grid provides a specific endpoint for your workspace. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: Paste a scoped Jungle Grid API key from the Jungle Grid portal.

get_job_status.label: Get Job Status
get_job_status.description: Get the current status and metadata for a submitted Jungle Grid job.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

get_job_runtime.label: Get Job Runtime
get_job_runtime.description: Get runtime tails, exit code, and runtime availability details for a Jungle Grid job.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

list_artifacts.label: List Job Artifacts
list_artifacts.description: List files produced by a Jungle Grid job when managed artifact storage is available.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

get_artifact_download_url.label: Get Artifact Download URL
get_artifact_download_url.description: Create a temporary signed download URL for a Jungle Grid artifact. Treat the returned URL as a secret.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

artifact_id.label: Artifact ID
artifact_id.description: The artifact ID returned by List Job Artifacts.

cancel_job.label: Cancel Job
cancel_job.description: Cancel a non-terminal Jungle Grid job. This may stop active execution.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: Optional cancellation reason stored with the Jungle Grid job status.
